title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Psalms 20: a prayer that Yahweh will answer in the day of trouble, banners in God's name, and trust not in chariots or horses.

questions.text: On what day does the psalm pray that Yahweh will answer you?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:1 says, "May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble."

questions.text: Whose name may set you up on high?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:1 says, "May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high."

questions.text: From where may Yahweh send help, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:2 asks that he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.

questions.text: What does verse 3 ask Yahweh to accept?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:3 asks him to remember all your offerings and accept your burned sacrifice.

questions.text: What does verse 4 ask that he grant you?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:4 says, "May he grant you your heart's desire, and fulfill all your counsel."

questions.text: In the name of our God, what will we set up?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:5 says, "In the name of our God, we will set up our banners."

questions.text: Whom does the speaker now know that Yahweh saves?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:6 says, "Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed."

questions.text: From where will Yahweh answer his anointed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:6 says he will answer him from his holy heaven.

answers.text: From the depths of the earth

questions.text: In what do some trust, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:7 says, "Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God."

questions.text: In the last verse, who do the people ask to answer them when they call?
questions.explanation: Psalms 20:9 says, "Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!"
